Workspace.Purpose: Represents the absolute root of the workspace directory hierarchy.
Relationships: `(Workspace)-[:CONTAINS]->(File)` (if a source file sits at the root directory)

WorkspaceFolder.Purpose: Represents a subdirectory inside a Workspace, housing projects or other folders outside projects. Cannot contain files directly (files outside projects are ignored).

Project.Purpose: Represents a buildable/compilable module or package directory (e.g. C# project, Go module, TS library, Python package).

ProjectFolder.Purpose: Represents a subdirectory inside a Project, containing files and other project folders.

Package.Purpose: Represents an external dependency package or workspace package referenced or produced by projects.

Dependencies.Purpose: Represents an intermediate node grouping external packages / third-party dependencies of a project.

Files.Purpose: Represents an intermediate node grouping all source code files and folders of a project.

DataBases.Purpose: Represents an intermediate node grouping all databases used by a project.

ApisInUse.Purpose: Represents an intermediate node grouping all external APIs used by a project.

CloudServices.Purpose: Represents an intermediate node grouping all cloud services used by a project.

DB.Purpose: Represents a database server or instance used by the project.

ApiInUse.Purpose: Represents an external API library or client service used by the project (e.g. NestJS, Axios, HttpClient).

CloudService.Purpose: Represents a cloud provider service used by the project (e.g. AWS S3, Stripe, Firebase).

File.Purpose: Represents a source code file containing parsable content.

Class.Purpose: Represents a parsed OOP class, struct, or concrete type definition.

Interface.Purpose: Represents a parsed OOP interface contract (e.g. C# interface, Go interface, TypeScript interface).

Function.Purpose: Represents a parsed method, function, subroutine, or procedure.

Variable.Purpose: Represents a declared field, variable, parameter, or property parsed from the AST.

GitSettings.Purpose: Represents the Git repository configuration settings for the workspace.

EntryPoint.Purpose: Represents an exposed API route, message listener, or application entry point.

EntryPoints.Purpose: Represents an intermediate node grouping all EntryPoint / API definition nodes of a project.
